root_causes.watchdog: test sent one heartbeat then stopped; watchdog fails (exit 75) when the child exits with heartbeat age >= pause. Fix: keep sending sequenced heartbeats every 0.10s until exit; pause 0.50s, chunk gaps 0.60s, silence_kill 20s. Interval must also stay slow enough not to hit the watchdog's >32-frame heartbeat-flood limit when the watchdog is starved (0.02s interval failed 13/30 for exactly that reason).
root_causes.memory_lifespan: catch-up worker builds its own store from the JSON path while the lifespan body writes concurrently; stores used non-atomic Path.write_text so the reader could see a truncated file, the factory raised inside the worker, and _catchup_worker_loop swallowed it and dropped the continuation (no memory_units call, no restart). Reproduced on whole-file order under load: failure state had no threads, no continuation, startup yielded. Fixed in institutional/persona stores (atomic os.replace) and hindsight_index._resolve_catchup_store (bounded retry), with deterministic unit tests.
root_causes.alpha_replication: lease_seconds=1 expired before _process_entry on a slow runner; now 300s with injected now=+3600s for the expired-claim recovery.
